Est. 2024

A cowboy-hat corner of Baler

ELBarako Café is a Western-themed coffee spot in Baler, Aurora. Hats line the walls, the neon glows orange, and there is always a seat, whether you want a quick cup or a long afternoon.

Order and pay at the counter, then settle in indoors, in the garden nook or up on the rooftop.

Drinks and plates to try

Our Facebook page lists coffee, pizza, sandwiches, pasta, pancakes, donuts, cupcakes and cakes. These are a few favorites from our photos.

Frappes

Caramel and chocolate, piled with whipped cream.

Katsu rice bowls

Crispy cutlet, shredded cabbage and creamy dressing.

Iced matcha latte

Layered green tea and milk with matcha art on top.

Ask at the counter or message us on Facebook for the full menu and prices.
